data.patent1Tagline: Complete protection for your skin & eyes.
data.patent1Lead: IRISPRO blocks UV400 (UVA1 380–400nm) and HEV Blue Light (380–420nm) at the source, helping protect your skin, eyes and health.
data.patent2Tagline: Stronger, more durable, built to last.
data.patent2Lead: 6 layers of advanced materials are hotmelted into one integrated base film for superior durability, optical clarity and long-term performance.

_unplaced.note: Copy from the technologies screen with no expressible section field. Preserved verbatim for the client / a future prose section type.
_unplaced.patent-1-intro: Patent 1 — UV+420™ Optical Technology. Complete protection for your skin & eyes. IRISPRO blocks UV400 (UVA1 380–400nm) and HEV Blue Light (380–420nm) at the source, helping protect your skin, eyes and health.
_unplaced.sputtering-intro: Multi-Layer Sputtering Technology. Reflect more heat. Stay cooler. Multi-layer sputtering reflects up to 98% of solar heat (IRR up to 1400nm) for maximum heat rejection without compromising visibility.
_unplaced.sputter-badge: SILVER SPUTTER — Highest Heat Reflectivity (placed as the Silver column tagline in the materials table)
_unplaced.installation-intro: Professional Installation System. Technology is only as good as the installation. We follow IWFA installation standards to ensure optimal performance, clarity and long-term warranty support.
_unplaced.manufacturing-strip: STRICT QUALITY CONTROL | CONSISTENT PERFORMANCE | BUILT FOR ASEAN CLIMATE
_unplaced.page-footnote: *Performance may vary based on film type, glass type, usage pattern, building design and climate.
_unplaced.section-numbering: The screen numbers its sections 01–05 (01 Patent 1 UV+420™, 02 Patent 2 6-Layer Hotmelt™, 03 Multi-Layer Sputtering, 04 Precision Manufacturing, 05 Professional Installation System).
